verdict.rationale: Notion's API/webhooks let developers subscribe to events (page updates, property changes, comments) and act on them via external code, but the evidence pack shows no native no-code 'if-this-then-that' rule builder for end users to define automatic triggers/actions inside the product itself. Missing for 10: documentation of Notion's built-in database automation/rules UI, evidence of AI-native users defining conditions without coding, and independent confirmation these webhook-based automations work reliably in practice.
